announcements.title: Azure Chaos Studio Workspaces, AKS extension now generally available
announcements.summary: Chaos Studio adds reusable workspace-based resilience experiments and a generally available AKS extension for controlled failure testing.
details: Workspaces group target resources and repeatable disruption scenarios, including zone loss and database failover.
The AKS extension tests pod recovery with a reduced permission requirement.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: The Book of News explicitly states that both Chaos Studio Workspaces and the AKS extension are generally available.

relevance.operations: Consider controlled recovery exercises for a customer-facing claims service.
relevance.risk: Consider repeatable resilience evidence for critical applications across operating environments.

announcements.nextStep: Choose a non-production service, define recovery objectives and approve a bounded failure experiment.

announcements.title: Azure expands confidential computing for protecting highly sensitive data
announcements.summary: Azure previews additional ways to protect data during processing, covering multi-GPU inference, smaller confidential execution boundaries and multiparty analytics.
details: VR72 targets confidential workloads spanning multiple GPUs.
Confidential Enclaves and AKS Kata CoCo containers narrow the trusted execution boundary.
Confidential Clean Room supports joint analysis without exposing participants' raw data to each other.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: All three offerings are described as preview. The source does not identify them as public previews.

relevance.operations: Explore whether confidential analytics could support sensitive claims-data collaboration.
relevance.risk: Explore controlled collaboration on risk data while validating residency and trust boundaries.

announcements.nextStep: Validate preview access, attestation, supported hardware and data-handling requirements before a pilot.

announcements.title: Built for the agentic AI era, Azure Cobalt 200 virtual machines are now generally available
announcements.summary: Cobalt 200 Arm-based VMs reach general availability, with selectable operating modes and new memory-intensive and storage-intensive VM options.
details: The source names consistent-speed and boost modes.
Mpsv4 targets large in-memory workloads; Lpsv5 targets storage-heavy applications.
Expansion to 24 regions is planned by year-end, not claimed as current availability everywhere.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: Cobalt 200 VMs are GA. The announced regional expansion is a future plan; confirm the target region and SKU.

relevance.operations: Consider benchmarking Arm-compatible services around claims or assistance applications.
relevance.risk: Consider workload-specific architecture choices for regional application platforms.

announcements.nextStep: Check application and dependency compatibility, then benchmark the actual workload without assuming advertised gains.

announcements.title: Azure expands agentic operations with new monitoring, AI capabilities
announcements.summary: Azure combines health context, natural-language operations and agent-assisted investigations across Monitor, Copilot, SRE Agent and Workload Center.
details: Azure Monitor natural-language capabilities and health models are GA.
Copilot spaces/custom skills and SRE Agent enhancements are preview; Oracle/SAP Workload Center capabilities are private preview.
SRE Agent updates include customer-managed keys, agent governance, agent-to-agent context, Teams and multicloud investigations.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: Monitor capabilities are GA; Copilot and SRE Agent additions are preview; Workload Center support is private preview.

relevance.operations: Discuss business-impact-based triage for customer-service application incidents.
relevance.risk: Discuss consistent incident context and approval boundaries across complex application estates.

announcements.nextStep: Map one service's dependencies and define which operational actions must remain approval-gated.

announcements.title: Azure infrastructure foundation for production AI applications and agents
announcements.summary: Azure previews a path from Foundry to customer-managed AKS, plus agent networking, isolated code execution and hybrid cluster capacity.
details: Foundry can target open-weight models and agents to customer AKS clusters.
Agent Grid centralizes policy; Agent Sandbox isolates generated code at VM level.
Flex nodes extend AKS to customer servers. Cobalt 200 is the GA exception within this announcement.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: The source explicitly places all listed capabilities in preview except Cobalt 200 VMs, which are GA.

relevance.operations: Explore infrastructure boundaries for agent-generated code before expanding automation.
relevance.risk: Explore agent placement choices against regional infrastructure and data-control requirements.

announcements.nextStep: Compare managed Foundry and AKS responsibilities, isolation, networking and regional capacity.

announcements.title: Introducing Azure Catalyst
announcements.summary: Azure Catalyst unifies discovery, migration planning and agent-assisted modernization across Azure and GitHub, with additional execution scenarios in preview.
details: Catalyst and the renamed Catalyst agent are GA.
Copilot modernization governance rulebooks and bring-your-own-model support are GA.
Deeper application/database modernization and BizTalk-to-Logic-Apps scenarios are preview additions.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: The umbrella experience and named existing capabilities are GA; expanded modernization and execution capabilities are preview.

relevance.operations: Consider assessing a bounded legacy workflow before choosing migration or redesign.
relevance.risk: Consider a shared assessment method for application, database and infrastructure dependencies.

announcements.nextStep: Inventory one application's dependencies and compare modernization options with engineering review.

announcements.title: Introducing Windows Server 2028
announcements.summary: Windows Server 2028 enters preview with updated security, storage and management, while hybrid AI inference has a separate limited early-access path.
details: Security work includes Server Core hardening, Trusted Launch, post-quantum cryptography and certificate management.
Infrastructure additions include NVMe improvements and ReFS boot.
Hybrid intelligence spans local runtimes, execution containers, Agent 365 and supported accelerated hardware.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: Security, performance and management features are in Windows Server Insider preview. Hybrid intelligence is limited early access with hardware requirements.

relevance.operations: Discuss a lab-based compatibility assessment for retained Windows workloads.
relevance.risk: Discuss hybrid inference options where application location and control requirements matter.

announcements.nextStep: Separate OS evaluation from restricted AI early access and document supported hardware.

announcements.title: Azure Cosmos DB improves development, retrieval and data protection
announcements.summary: Cosmos DB adds developer tooling, retrieval improvements and independent backup protection, alongside a preview AI-assisted data modeler.
details: Shell and the Rust SDK are GA.
Semantic reranking and FuzzyBM25 score projection are GA.
Vault-based Azure Backup is GA; the VS Code AI data modeler and related extension updates are preview.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: The source marks the named shell, SDK, retrieval and backup features GA and the AI-assisted VS Code updates preview.
announcements.discrepancy: The introduction says seven updates, but the published list contains six named bullets. No seventh feature has been invented.

relevance.operations: Consider retrieval quality and recoverability for a document-backed service application.
relevance.risk: Consider developer consistency and independent backup controls for distributed data applications.

announcements.nextStep: Evaluate retrieval relevance on representative non-sensitive queries and test backup recovery separately.

announcements.title: Azure DocumentDB expands developer tools, sovereignty and security
announcements.summary: Azure DocumentDB expands MongoDB-compatible development and provisioning, with preview hybrid deployment options and collection-level access controls.
details: The VS Code extension and near-instant provisioning for M10-M30 clusters are GA.
Azure Arc and Azure Local deployment options are preview.
Database- and collection-scoped custom roles are preview.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: Developer extension/provisioning are GA; Arc, Azure Local and fine-grained RBAC are preview.

relevance.operations: Explore narrower permissions for teams working with document-based applications.
relevance.risk: Explore hybrid document-store placement against sovereignty and operational requirements.

announcements.nextStep: Confirm API compatibility, supported topology and least-privilege requirements before considering migration.

announcements.title: Azure HorizonDB generally available for mission-critical applications
announcements.summary: Azure HorizonDB becomes a generally available PostgreSQL-compatible service, with preview AI-in-SQL features and Fabric mirroring.
details: The service includes Entra authentication, private endpoints, managed identities, encryption and multi-zone resilience.
AI model management, AI Functions and AI Pipelines are preview.
The PostgreSQL VS Code extension is GA; mirroring into Fabric is preview.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: Azure HorizonDB and the VS Code extension are GA. The listed AI and Fabric mirroring extensions are preview.

relevance.operations: Consider operational-to-analytical patterns for a carefully scoped claims-data application.
relevance.risk: Consider PostgreSQL platform options and governed analytical access to transactional data.

announcements.nextStep: Distinguish Azure HorizonDB from the separate Fabric HorizonDB preview and validate service requirements.

announcements.title: Azure Managed Redis previews Redis 8 and an agent kit
announcements.summary: Azure Managed Redis previews Redis 8 capabilities and an agent kit that reviews application configuration and recommends changes.
details: Redis 8 combines JSON, search, time-series and vector-oriented data capabilities.
Potential agent patterns include context, memory and reuse of relevant responses.
The agent kit reviews connectivity, reliability and performance settings; developers evaluate its recommendations.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: Both Redis 8 in Azure Managed Redis and the agent kit are explicitly preview.

relevance.operations: Explore caching or session-context patterns with clear retention boundaries.
relevance.risk: Explore consistent cache configuration checks across application teams.

announcements.nextStep: Test cache invalidation, sensitive-data retention and connection behavior in a non-production pilot.

announcements.title: Azure SQL expands modernization, resiliency and local development options
announcements.summary: Azure SQL expands Managed Instance resilience and migration options, and previews a local Azure SQL Database container for development.
details: Next-gen General Purpose zone redundancy and flexible memory on eligible Premium-series instances are GA.
Managed Instance link support for multi-database Always On groups is GA.
The local container previews matching Azure SQL Database engine behavior, including vector and encrypted-data development scenarios.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: Named Managed Instance changes are GA; the local Azure SQL Database container is preview. Free local development does not mean free cloud/model usage.

relevance.operations: Discuss recovery and integration-testing options for SQL-backed insurance applications.
relevance.risk: Discuss phased database modernization with explicit cutover and recovery criteria.

announcements.nextStep: Check tier/region prerequisites and exercise a representative migration or local integration test.

announcements.title: Database Hub in Fabric generally available; SQL and PostgreSQL database agents in preview
announcements.summary: Database Hub in Fabric reaches GA for estate-wide database oversight, while SQL and PostgreSQL operations agents enter preview.
details: The hub spans Azure, Fabric, on-premises and other-cloud database environments.
Agents use operational signals and Microsoft-authored skills to investigate performance and health.
Agent recommendations and approved actions respect existing permissions and audit boundaries; PostgreSQL assistance also appears in VS Code.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: Database Hub is GA. SQL/PostgreSQL database agents and the associated new agent experiences are preview.

relevance.operations: Consider a consolidated view of databases supporting claims and service workloads.
relevance.risk: Consider consistent health investigations across a distributed database estate.

announcements.nextStep: Inventory supported databases and test an approval-gated performance investigation.

announcements.title: Microsoft Fabric HorizonDB brings PostgreSQL to Fabric in preview
announcements.summary: Fabric HorizonDB previews serverless PostgreSQL inside Fabric, connecting app transactions with OneLake analytics and managed application backends.
details: Databases scale with demand and pause when idle.
Fabric apps can use a managed backend with data APIs, authentication, storage and hosting.
Translytical queries, mirroring and reverse ETL connect live application data and Fabric analytical data.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: Fabric HorizonDB and its described new capabilities are preview, distinct from Azure HorizonDB's GA announcement.

relevance.operations: Explore a governed claims-workflow prototype that combines records and analytical context.
relevance.risk: Explore a risk-review application using shared analytical and transactional data.

announcements.nextStep: Validate preview limits, transaction semantics, security boundaries and capacity behavior.

announcements.title: PostgreSQL on Azure simplifies migration and expands modernization options
announcements.summary: PostgreSQL on Azure adds migration paths, compute choices and stronger recovery options, with availability varying by capability.
details: Oracle-to-PostgreSQL and Azure PostgreSQL-to-HorizonDB DMS migration paths are preview.
Burstable v2 and expanded snapshot-based Azure Backup are preview.
Cobalt 200 compute, AMD v6 confidential compute, PITR immutability and same-zone-to-zone-redundant HA conversion are GA.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: The source separates GA compute/protection/HA updates from preview migration, burstable and backup capabilities.

relevance.operations: Consider assessing migration effort and backup protection for PostgreSQL candidates.
relevance.risk: Consider workload-specific PostgreSQL architecture, resilience and data-in-use controls.

announcements.nextStep: Choose one migration scenario and validate compatibility, online synchronization and restore behavior.

announcements.title: Power BI introduces custom data app creation in preview
announcements.summary: Power BI Pro users gain preview app creation in Desktop, turning governed semantic models into interactive experiences with write-back.
details: Natural-language app creation starts from a trusted Power BI semantic model.
Data apps can collect input, update records and write to underlying sources.
The announcement extends access to Fabric Database capabilities for analytical and transactional app scenarios.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: Purpose-built data app creation for Power BI Pro customers is preview. Do not equate this with every Fabric app capability being GA.

relevance.operations: Explore a claims exception tracker or approval prototype on governed measures.
relevance.risk: Explore a portfolio-review workflow that combines analysis and controlled updates.

announcements.nextStep: Prototype with non-sensitive data and validate write-back authorization, audit and licensing details.

announcements.title: Rayfin and Fabric apps reach general availability
announcements.summary: Rayfin and Fabric apps become GA, combining application backends, trusted enterprise data and centralized governance.
details: Apps can connect to semantic models, warehouses and lakehouses, with SQL or Fabric HorizonDB backend choices.
The announcement includes OneLake Governance hub app oversight, security controls and observability.
Integrations connect app creation with Copilot Managed Runtime and Power BI.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: Rayfin and Fabric apps are GA. Fabric HorizonDB remains preview in 1.3.7; Power BI Pro app creation remains preview in 1.3.9.

relevance.operations: Discuss a managed backend for an internal claims or service application.
relevance.risk: Discuss reusing governed business definitions in applications rather than duplicating them.

announcements.nextStep: Compare supported GA app paths and separately evaluate any preview database or authoring dependencies.

announcements.title: Turning production experience into better agents
announcements.summary: Foundry connects evaluation, production insights, human feedback, agent optimization and model training into an iterative improvement workflow.
details: Multi-turn evaluation, production insights and Agent Optimizer are GA.
Human annotation and new safety support for generated rubric evaluators are preview.
Managed and Programmed Training preview options adapt supported models; teams compare changes against a baseline.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: The source explicitly distinguishes GA evaluation/insights/optimizer capabilities from preview annotation, safety and training additions.

relevance.operations: Consider measuring a service-assistant conversation against expert-reviewed examples.
relevance.risk: Consider controlled model and agent changes against risk-domain quality criteria.

announcements.nextStep: Define a verified evaluation set and approval gate before enabling optimization or training.

announcements.title: Microsoft-Decision-1.1 now generally available
announcements.summary: Microsoft-Decision-1.1 becomes GA for constrained routing, classification, prioritization and verification, with confidence scores and image-aware instructions.
details: The model chooses among developer-permitted actions rather than replacing general-purpose reasoning.
Confidence can support deferral when uncertainty is high.
The source describes integration with Copilot request routing and Cowork effort selection.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: The model is explicitly GA in Foundry and through named distribution platforms. Task suitability still requires evaluation.

relevance.operations: Explore low-risk work-queue routing with human escalation for uncertain cases.
relevance.risk: Explore document categorization or workflow routing, not autonomous underwriting decisions.

announcements.nextStep: Evaluate class balance, calibration, permitted actions and human escalation on representative data.

announcements.title: Microsoft Foundry adds new AI models for coding, images, security
announcements.summary: Foundry broadens model choice across coding, image generation, security, decision-making and routing, with platform-specific release stages.
details: MAI-Code-2 and Flash are GA in GitHub; Code-2-Flash is private preview in Foundry.
Image-2.7 variants are preview; Cyber-2-Flash is preview only inside MDASH.
Decision-1.1 is GA; router updates expand choices; fal video models and Baseten on Foundry are preview.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: Availability differs by model and host. GitHub GA must not be read as Foundry GA or unrestricted access to cyber models.

relevance.operations: Consider task-based model evaluation for developer and internal-assistance scenarios.
relevance.risk: Consider model/host choice against data controls, cost and approved use cases.

announcements.nextStep: Compare eligible deployments using the same quality, latency, cost and data-handling criteria.

announcements.title: Microsoft Copilot SDK 2.0 improves security and scale for AI apps
announcements.summary: Copilot SDK 2.0 reaches GA with a Rust-based agent harness, six-language support and enterprise application integration.
details: The harness is designed for embedding agents in applications.
The source emphasizes multi-tenant, high-scale use and enterprise security.
Production use within Microsoft/GitHub is context, not a guarantee of application-level outcomes.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: Copilot SDK 2.0 is explicitly generally available.

relevance.operations: Explore embedding a bounded assistant into an internal service application.
relevance.risk: Explore consistent agent integration patterns across independently managed applications.

announcements.nextStep: Validate supported languages, tenant isolation, tool permissions and application-level evaluation.

announcements.title: Agent 365 turns AI spend into business value with FinOps for AI
announcements.summary: Agent 365 adds AI cost management and business analytics, connecting usage-based spend, guardrails and outcome-oriented reporting.
details: Cost Management previews centralized policies, limits, alerts and Fabric-based reporting.
Forecasting and natural-language analysis arrive through Frontier this month; broader value/delegation capabilities are planned for December.
Business Analytics is available through Frontier, with distinct Microsoft-service and third-party licensing prerequisites.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: Cost Management is preview; analytics/forecasting use Frontier access; the source schedules additional expansion for December.

relevance.operations: Discuss cost visibility for a bounded assistance pilot before broader use.
relevance.risk: Discuss accountable AI usage reporting and chargeback across organizational units.

announcements.nextStep: Confirm eligibility and licensing, then define spend guardrails and measurable task outcomes.

announcements.title: Autopilot is rolling out to Frontier customers
announcements.summary: Autopilot begins a Frontier rollout as a persistent personal-work agent with its own identity, memory and managed access to tools.
details: The agent can follow up on threads and perform recurring or long-running work.
Teams colleagues can mention it for supported requests.
Admin visibility and safety checks apply to actions associated with the agent's identity.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: Rolling out through the Frontier program; the source does not announce general availability.

relevance.operations: Explore follow-up preparation and recurring internal tasks with explicit supervision.
relevance.risk: Explore persistent assistance while separating personal authority from agent identity.

announcements.nextStep: Check Frontier eligibility and define permitted tools, retention, ownership and escalation rules.

announcements.title: Copilot Managed Runtime is now generally available, with new capabilities
announcements.summary: Copilot Managed Runtime becomes GA, with optional Fabric backend integration and new local-to-Studio agent/workflow development paths.
details: Hosting and governance are separate from the tool used to build the app.
Optional Fabric services provide database, storage and data APIs.
The new agent/workflow path supports local changes, CLI publishing and version-controlled collaboration.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: The runtime is explicitly GA. The announcement does not give a separate release stage for every newly announced integration and development capability.

relevance.operations: Discuss a governed hosting route for an internal workflow app.
relevance.risk: Discuss application lifecycle controls across business-built and developer-built experiences.

announcements.nextStep: Validate the supported publishing path and backend status for a specific application design.

announcements.title: Copilot Workspaces helps teams work together with Copilot
announcements.summary: Copilot Workspaces evolves Notebooks into a shared workstream space for people, documents and Copilot-assisted coordination.
details: Work IQ suggests relevant workspaces and supplies shared context.
Copilot surfaces changes, unresolved work and actions.
Bringing personal Autopilot agents into Workspaces is described as coming soon.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: Workspaces is available through Frontier. Autopilot collaboration within Workspaces is a future capability.

relevance.operations: Explore a shared internal workspace for preparing a complex service review.
relevance.risk: Explore coordinated workstream context across a project team with controlled access.

announcements.nextStep: Test membership, document permissions and handoff behavior before broadening a workspace pilot.

announcements.title: Dynamics 365 CRM and ERP plugins now available in Copilot
announcements.summary: Dynamics 365 Sales and ERP plugins become GA in Copilot, exposing business context and supported sales, finance and operations actions.
details: Sales supports account planning, meeting preparation, deal insights and presentation creation.
ERP skills support finance and operations workflows in Cowork and Excel, including sourcing-to-purchasing tasks.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: Both the Sales plugin and the ERP apps plugin are explicitly generally available.
announcements.discrepancy: The Book of News Learn more link points to an A365AnalyticsLearn short URL. The numbered Book of News section is retained as the authoritative source for these plugins.

relevance.operations: Consider assisted procurement or meeting preparation if the relevant Dynamics apps are in scope.
relevance.risk: Consider finance/operations assistance with existing business permissions and approvals.

announcements.nextStep: Confirm application licensing, supported actions and approval requirements rather than assuming deployment fit.

announcements.title: Easily build secure apps with Copilot Code
announcements.summary: Copilot Code enables natural-language app creation through Frontier, with tenant-hosted cloud projects and a local Windows sandbox.
details: Supported apps can publish through Copilot Managed Runtime and appear in administrative tooling.
Code is available through Frontier on Windows, web, iOS and Android.
The local sandbox is available on Windows; macOS support is coming soon; GA is announced for December.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: Current access is through Frontier. December GA and future macOS sandbox support must not be presented as available today.

relevance.risk: Explore business-led prototyping within approved publishing and sandbox boundaries.

announcements.title: Home in the Microsoft Copilot app
announcements.summary: Copilot Home unifies Chat and Cowork, adds routing guidance and brings Office editing into the Copilot app, with advanced agent features at earlier release stages.
details: Home is rolling out worldwide; Chat-to-Cowork recommendations and Office in Copilot are GA.
Decision-based Cowork effort selection is Frontier.
Cowork use of existing declarative agents is private preview through Frontier; files inherit OneDrive/Microsoft 365 controls.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: The section combines worldwide rollout and GA features with Frontier and private-preview agent capabilities.

relevance.risk: Discuss permissions-aware collaboration while evaluating advanced Cowork features separately.

announcements.nextStep: Verify tenant rollout and distinguish licensed GA Office workflows from restricted agent previews.

announcements.title: Microsoft expands Dynamics 365 Activate to support agentic ERP migration
announcements.summary: Dynamics 365 Activate extends its migration assistance from CRM toward SAP ECC-to-ERP assessment and implementation workflows.
details: The Salesforce CRM migration experience is GA.
ERP discovery examines processes, configurations, customizations and dependencies.
Requirements, configuration and data-migration capabilities roll out over the coming weeks, with teams validating recommendations.
announcements.availabilityEvidence: Salesforce CRM migration is GA. New ERP capabilities start rolling out at the event and continue over subsequent weeks without a blanket GA claim.

announcements.nextStep: Confirm actual scenario eligibility and require business/implementation review of discovery findings.

announcements.summary: Microsoft and Salesforce connect CRM context to Copilot and Teams, alongside GA zero-copy federation from Fabric OneLake into Data 360.
details: Salesforce in Copilot is preview, using authenticated MCP access and prebuilt sales skills.
Sales Cloud in Teams is a pilot.

announcements.availabilityEvidence: Copilot integration is preview; Teams integration is pilot; the specifically described Fabric-to-Data-360 federation is GA.

announcements.summary: Today previews a proactive Copilot/Outlook experience that highlights priorities and prepares messages or scheduling changes for user approval.
details: Today Brief provides a morning briefing under a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.
Today Feed refreshes throughout the day and requires Copilot credits.
Prepared actions remain reviewable rather than being described as automatically approved.

announcements.nextStep: Confirm preview access, approval behavior and credit consumption before selecting pilot users.

announcements.title: Edge for Business adds governed AI workflows, stronger security

announcements.summary: Web IQ reaches GA for Azure customers, adding controlled web grounding and specialized external context, with commerce data in private preview.
